rule: D-387 (2): item_id is freeze_splits.load_axis's (the first 16 hex of sha256 of the UTF-8 of the stripped prompt, after its cleaning); side = ('ATTACK', 'MEASURE')[sha256(item_id.encode('utf-8')).digest()[0] & 1]: an even first byte ATTACK, an odd one MEASURE. ATTACK: attack training (D-388, D-389) and the transfer surrogate; MEASURE: capability cost only, never training or tuning an attacker

datasets_cache.note: HF_DATASETS_CACHE is a fresh directory made for this run on NVMe before datasets is imported. Any cleanup the datasets library does of its own Arrow cache (on a failed load its builder removes its '.incomplete' directory, freeze_splits.load_axis -> load_dataset) is therefore confined to this run's directory. That library-internal cleanup is the one remaining deletion in this pipeline, and it is the author's to accept. The directory is left after the run; removal is a human's scripts/safe_rm.sh call.

loader: freeze_splits.load_axis through phase2_pool_clusters.load_pool, offline, the snapshot's files equal to the fetch record's before and after the read; spec: the Phase 1 WildGuardMix spec (text field 'prompt', label field 'prompt_harm_label', harmful 1 / unharmful 0, extra fields adversarial and subcategory) with config wildguardtest, split test

split_file.format: load_axis's fields plus 'side'; sorted by item_id; json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) and LF (freeze_splits.write_jsonl's format)
